messages.text: Which miner should I buy?
Used the purchase-research skill
Used the search-discovery skill
Read the bsb b30 page
Read the magic miner 40t page

Two picks, both pre-sale.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at about 650 W, tunable 30 to 50. Cheapest per terahash we sell. Ships November 14.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W. Quieter and lighter on power, so it's the one if your electricity is expensive or it lives in the house. Ships October 30.

Tell me the state or country you'd run it in and I'll run your sats per month and power cost at that rate.

i wanted to talk to an agent, did u recently have any shipping to Serbia? because of our customs i am afraid to order, they charge a lot for customs + vat etc. i know u guys do ddp that fits me but what if the package doesnt arrive what do we do? how am i protected? i am thinking btw thor p2 and kbox, totally different but anyhow for lottery it doesnt matter, i wish something that can ship asap
Handed to the team · Asked for an agent; also a Serbia customs/lost-parcel protection question I can'
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe NerdQaxe Hammer BC04 in stock bitcoin miner

I've pinged Abel and Georges, they'll jump into this chat, so stay here with me.

Two things I can answer now. We don't ship DDP. Prices are USD with VAT and duties excluded, so Serbian customs bills you on delivery and we can't quote that figure. And neither unit you're weighing is immediate: the Thor P2 ships October 3, the K-Box runs about a 19 day lead time.

Shipping now with the EU plug: NerdQX, 8 TH/s, $299.99, or the Hammer BC04, 6 TH/s, $239.
oh i believe i talked to support and they said u do, my bad, i guess in that way the miner would cost x2 and thats too much ;(

It won't be double. Customs charge a percentage of the declared value, not the price over again, so on a $239 BC04 you're looking at a surcharge, not another $239. I won't guess the exact Serbian figure though.

Abel or Georges is already on the way into this chat. They can tell you what recent Serbia shipments actually got charged, and clear up what you were told about DDP. Worth giving them a couple of minutes before you decide.
ok waiting

Good. They're on it.

While you wait, one thing worth knowing: for pure lottery odds it's hashrate per dollar that counts, and the NerdQX gives you 8 TH/s for $299.99 against the BC04's 6 TH/s for $239. The B.04 pulls less power though, about 100W versus 145W.

Both are in stock with the EU plug, which is what Serbia takes. Want me to hold one in a cart so it's ready if you go ahead?
i wanted the newest chip i already have bm1370 in nerdqx

Then it's the BM1373 you're after, one generation on from your NerdQX.

In stock today there's the Hammer Thor X1, 3.2 TH/s, $219, BM1373, but it's USB-C powered with no PSU in the box and 3.2 TH/s is a step down from what you already run.

The real BM1373 units are the Thor P2, 10 TH/s, $369, shipping October 3, and the Harlo B30, 30 TH/s, $899, October 30.

Which of those fits your budget?

i wanted thor p2 that was my first pick but here customs dont charge if the package is less then 50$ u can say its some used old gpu or w/e just no mentioning that its a miner, i wanted to go for kbox cause we can say its heater

That one's a no, sorry. We declare the real value and the real contents on every parcel, so a $369 miner ships as a $369 miner. Nobody here can change that, and a wrongly declared parcel lands on you at Serbian customs, not on us.

The T. P2 was your first pick and I think it's the right one: 10 TH/s, BM1373, $369, October 3.

Abel or Georges is still on the way and can tell you what Serbia typically charges.
sure let me know but i know how it goes goods + shipping x 10-20% customs + 20% vat equal waste of money
Ran the power-cost calculator

Fair math, but the customs percentage is the same whatever you buy, so it only changes your cost per terahash. Thor P2 is about $37/TH. The B30 is $30, the Magic Miner 40T is $20. Add 35% to each and the Magic Miner is still the cheapest hashrate you can land in Serbia.

At $0.17/kWh (I don't have a Serbian rate, give me yours and I'll rerun) the Magic Miner stacks about 57,900 sats a month, worth $48, against $81 of power, with roughly a 1 in 165,000 daily shot at a $266k block. The T. P2 is a quarter of that hashrate for a third of the price.

Honest version: at retail power this is stacking sats and a lottery ticket, not profit. The Magic Miner ships November 14 though, so it's not the fast one.
i am too long in crypto since 2012. thanks, but i buy this as a true fan... so i am looking for the best option i know its just a entusiast purchase

Then it's the Harlo B30. It's the only BM1373 unit here that isn't a toy: 30 TH/s at 360 to 450W, built-in PSU, around 50 dB, $899, ships October 30. Newest chip, best efficiency we sell, and triple the Thor P2's hashrate for not much more power.

Worth knowing the early B30 sample was loud. The second revision fixed that, and that's what ships.

Want me to build the cart so it's ready when you decide?
i would be interested in b30 but i need to count the total expenses for it

Running cost: 405W, so roughly 292 kWh a month, times your per kWh price.
